description: Team + skill edition for the carpentry and construction career: trade craft (framing, joinery, repair, improvised shopcraft) bundled with career-skill development (plan reading, layout mastery, estimating, mentoring, tool craft, job closeout) and crew team-plays (huddles, lift choreography, signals, handoffs, safety sweeps, re-sequencing). Built to refine the craft, level up the career, and grow toward personal refinement tools. Every entry follows the Sidewinder structure (mechanism first, improvise with what's on hand, steps, explicit stop conditions) and treats load-bearing and code-regulated work as hard stops for a licensed pro or engineer.
name: Carpentry & Construction
notes_for_framework: All entries use domain 'home'; a future 'outdoor' or 'general' domain may fit fence/garden entries better.
Structural-safety stop conditions are mandatory per entry; the framework validator should require a load-bearing/engineer stop on any build-track entry.

track_emphasis.build: heavy — framing, shelves, benches, fences, and outdoor structures from scratch
track_emphasis.combine: light — repurposing slabs and reclaimed stock into new builds
track_emphasis.create: light — cut-list design and built-in planning from measurements
track_emphasis.improvise: core — doing real carpentry with no proper tools is the Sidewinder doctrine in its native habitat
track_emphasis.restore: heavy — repair and refurbish is most of the trade's daily work
